description: Declaration of the StaticMapIterator template class used for iterating over a StaticMap in the breakpad project, including iterator operations and data access methods.

classes.name: StaticMapIterator
classes.description: A const iterator class for traversing a StaticMap, providing increment/decrement and data retrieval interfaces.

methods.name: GetKeyPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the key at the current iterator position.

methods.name: GetKey
methods.description: Returns the key value at the current iterator position.

methods.name: GetValueRawPtr
methods.description: Returns a raw pointer to the value data.

methods.name: GetValuePtr
methods.description: Returns a typed pointer to the value data.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the iterator is valid for use.
